Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Loro Esha: 19-year-old woman, 191 cm (very-tall), unmistakably soft rounded construction with a clearly evident, naturally wider middle, short-to-average limbs, no cinched or flat waist, and gentle limb contours, skin value band-5-medium-deep. Face: long narrow face; deep-set eyes and a heavy level brow; aquiline nose, softly full mouth; no added facial mark. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: gray-white-silver, bob-pageboy, deliberate accent: hidden undercut. Wardrobe: short-jacket-trousers, specifically a shaped short jacket, practical closures, generous trousers, and low boots; a high soft collar and uneven layered hems; bounded palette plum-gray. Visible personal details: a dense freckle field. Make a tattoo, scar, freckle field, or birthmark the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: low-maintenance grooming with highly polished footwear. Color treatment: keeps color restrained to layered edges. Pose cue: stance is broad and still, with one palm turned slightly upward. Include a travel tally cord only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow. No affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, text, extra person, duplicated anatomy, cropped extremity, or published-character resemblance.
